description: This file contains functions and types related to detecting, scanning, warning about, and repairing stale plugin configurations within the OpenClaw project. It manages plugin registry state, identifies stale plugin references, and provides mechanisms for auto-repair.

methods.name: collectPluginRegistryState
methods.description: Collects the current plugin registry state, including known plugin IDs and discovery error status.

methods.name: isStalePluginAutoRepairBlocked
methods.description: Checks if auto-repair of stale plugins is blocked due to discovery errors.

methods.name: scanStalePluginConfig
methods.description: Scans the plugin configuration for stale plugin references that are not recognized in the current registry.

methods.name: collectStalePluginConfigWarnings
methods.description: Generates warning messages for detected stale plugin references, indicating whether auto-removal is paused or needs manual intervention.

methods.name: maybeRepairStalePluginConfig
methods.description: Attempts to automatically repair stale plugin references in the configuration if auto-repair is not blocked.
